title: Base 12 - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile's James Grime makes the case for base 12 (dozenal) over base 10, showing how twelve's many divisors make arithmetic and everyday fractions easier.
why: HN uses it as the accessible overview of the dozenal system whenever base 12 or the 12 times table comes up.
